tools.name: historico_de_preco
tools.description: Observed price series for an AliExpress product. Accepts the itemId or the product URL. Also returns the number of readings and days of tracking: with too little tracking there is no basis to claim a drop, and the response says so explicitly.

tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the lowest (or cheapest) price of an AliExpress product over a period: "lowest price in the last 30 days", "has it been cheaper?", "is this the lowest price ever?". tools.name: alternativas_mais_baratas
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a cheaper option, an alternative, or the same product from another store. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quedas_de_preco" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Products whose price dropped at least 10% below the TYPICAL price of the last 14 days (median weighted by how long each price lasted — a flash sale only counts for the hours it ran).
